description: GitHub data. Repository stats, user profiles, and code-search results (stars, forks, language, topics, issues) via the GitHub REST API. [$0.02/call]. Params — mode: what to fetch (repo|search|user); repos: comma list of owner/name (mode=repo); q: search query (mode=search); usernames: comma list (mode=user); maxItems: integer Example params: {'mode': 'repo', 'repos': 'microsoft/vscode'}
name: github
